instance.title: General
instance.subtitle: Configure instance-wide preferences
instance.deploymentLocalTrusted: Local trusted mode is optimized for a local operator. Browser requests run as local board context and no sign-in is required.
instance.deploymentPublic: Authenticated public mode requires sign-in for board access and is intended for public URLs.
instance.deploymentPrivate: Authenticated private mode requires sign-in and is intended for LAN, VPN, or other private-network deployments.
instance.censorDescription: Hide the username segment in home-directory paths and similar operator-visible log output. Standalone username mentions outside of paths are not yet masked in the live transcript view. This is off by default.
instance.backupDescription: Configure how long automatic database backups are retained. Backups run roughly every hour and are compressed with gzip. Within the daily window all backups are kept; beyond that, one backup per week and one per month are preserved.
instance.feedbackDescription: Control whether thumbs up and thumbs down votes can send the voted AI output to Paperclip Labs. Votes are always saved locally.
instance.feedbackPromptNote: No default is saved yet. The next thumbs up or thumbs down choice will ask once and then save the answer here.
instance.dontAllowDescription: Keep voted AI outputs local only.
instance.devNoteA: To retest the first-use prompt in local dev, remove the
instance.devNoteC: JSON row for this instance, or set it back to
instance.devNoteE: both mean no default has been chosen yet.
